chunks: ALL THAT IS in the heavens and the earth sings the praises of God. He is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that all in the heavens and earth glorify God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *tasbih* (glorification) as an inherent attribute of all creation, reflecting the cosmic order established by the Almighty and All-Wise. It serves as a theological foundation for understanding the unity of existence (*wahdat al-wujud*) under God's sovereign will, where every entity, whether conscious or unconscious, participates in divine praise. This affirmation reinforces the belief in God's absolute control over both the celestial and terrestrial realms.
